activation: OPT_IN_ONLY: crypto_candidate_promotion_packet/2 (contract/2) stays the default and byte-identical; a caller must request contract 3 explicitly

regime_source.applicable_decision_rule: the runtime decision whose current_decision_date equals the UTC decision date in force at the promotion reference instant (07:00Z boundary); an older decision is UNKNOWN with no carry; a decision evaluated after the reference instant is rejected as lookahead

regime_gate.note: Multipliers are carried as lineage for downstream sizing only; P5-08 opens no sizing, buy, order or capital authority. NEUTRAL selectivity is enforced by the required T2_ROTATION_MEMBERSHIP condition.

market_evidence_policy.pass_rule: packet bound to the ratified policy; 1d and 4h candle evidence PASS; trade evidence PASS; orderbook FRESH with full ratified depth, ratified slippage notional, spread_bps <= max_spread_bps_normal and slippage_bps <= max_slippage_bps_normal recomputed from the packet numbers
market_evidence_policy.breach: VOLUME_LIQUIDITY UNKNOWN with named reasons (P4-07 fail_closed_unknown); a QUALITY_WARNING under the T2 rule, never a promotion blocker

blocking_conditions.T2_IDENTITY: resolved identity via the ratified Upbit market registry (P3-12 identity gate)
blocking_conditions.T2_POPULATION_MEMBERSHIP: in-scope row of the validated P3-12 population snapshot for the evaluation date
blocking_conditions.T2_PRICE_DATA: finalized 1d candle for the latest completed UTC day present with available_at <= reference instant
blocking_conditions.T2_ROTATION_MEMBERSHIP: asset bucket (BTC/ETH/ALT) STRONG_CONFIRMED or STRONG_HELD under RULE.ROTATION.CRYPTO.V1 / RULE.ROTATION.COMMON_T1T2_NEUTRAL.V1; no confirmation source is wired into P5-08 yet, so UNKNOWN

promotion_rule.state_rule: any T2 required condition FAIL -> BLOCKED; otherwise any UNKNOWN -> WATCH; otherwise FOCUSED_REVIEW. Non-blocking criteria never change the state; they are emitted as warnings.
promotion_rule.missing_input: a missing required input is UNKNOWN (fail closed), never PASS

rule_refs_shape: {rule_id, version, registry_sha256 (null until the rule registry is on main), source_record_sha256, role in APPLIED|BLOCKED_BY}; unapplied_rules {rule_id, reason_code}
